blocks.input_text:
[請求項1]
或る分野に関連する複数の技術と前記分野に関連する複数の製品又はサービスとを含む前記分野に関連する複数の事象を示す文字列が時間軸上に配置されたロードマップのうち、前記製品又はサービスごとに、当該製品又はサービスに関する環境負荷値を消費対象ごとに計算するように構成されている計算部と、
前記環境負荷値が最大となる消費対象の環境負荷値の算定式の項ごとに、当該項の意味を示す文字列との類似性に基づいて、前記ロードマップに配置された文字列のうち当該項に関連する文字列を特定するように構成されている特定部と、
特定された文字列を出力するように構成されている出力部と、
を有することを特徴とする情報処理装置。
blocks.output_text:
[Claim 1]
Information processing apparatus, wherein a calculation unit configured to calculate, for each product or service, an environmental load value related to the product or service for each consumption target in a roadmap in which a character string indicating a plurality of events related to the field including a plurality of technologies related to the field and a plurality of products or services related to the field is arranged on a time axis; and; an identification unit configured to identify, for each term of an expression for calculating an environmental load value of a consumption target having a maximum environmental load value, a character string related to the term among character strings arranged in the roadmap based on similarity to a character string indicating a meaning of the term; and an output unit configured to output an identified character string.

[Claim 2]
The information processing apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the identification unit is configured to identify the character string associated with each term of a formula for calculating an environmental load value of a consumption target that maximizes an environmental load value for a product or a service that most slowly appears on the time axis when a consumption target that maximizes an environmental load value differs among the plurality of products or services.
